scope: Review the feature-guide consolidation against docs/documentation-editorial-guide.md: titles, summaries, openings, reader scope, section hierarchy, retained procedures and warnings, localized meaning and precise links to relocated task sections.
method: Read the editorial guide and all EN/FR guide titles, summaries and section headings; reviewed the consolidated feature prose and operational caveats with their EN/FR counterparts.

Before editing, compare every original body block with the corresponding consolidated guide after ignoring heading text, whitespace and Markdown link destinations. All 549 English and 551 French non-heading baseline blocks were present, including executable examples, limitations and warnings.

Review the new EN/FR feature openings together, tying their claims to the retained body. Single-source guides retain focused task/explanation openings and summaries rather than receiving filler introductions.
After editing, verify every original fenced code block and image reference is still present, workflow coverage is preserved, and EN/FR heading IDs and levels remain identical.

Review installation redundancy by keeping complete explanations at the first location and adding section links at later locations. Keep the missing-npm prerequisite before worker-image build commands.
limitations: This is an editorial and retained-meaning review, not execution of the described UI tasks, server installation, update, backup, restore, provider setup or release validation.
Prior procedure, screenshot and release evidence is inherited. No new capture, external-provider backup or restoration was performed by this reviewer.
The parent runs repository-wide automated checks and rendered navigation validation. These checks do not establish successful execution of every documented workflow.

findings.finding: Merged guides opened with their first old task rather than their overall feature scope.
findings.resolution: Added concise paired feature openings to the 19 multi-source guides, with meaningful distinctions and prerequisites drawn from the retained procedures.

findings.finding: The Pages summary and export heading implied a general page import control absent from its procedure.
findings.resolution: Describe page export/printing, and explicitly direct supported imports to the empty-database workflow. Preserve the legacy section ID.

findings.finding: The French database-schema heading promised no data loss despite irreversible column deletion and value-clearing conversion.
findings.resolution: Remove the no-data-loss promise while retaining the warnings, confirmation requirements and conversion checks.

findings.finding: The English API failure heading addressed a writer instead of an integrator.
findings.resolution: Rename it to Handle failed requests and delivery limits, retaining the stable section ID.

findings.finding: Installation repeated runner blockers, missing package managers and storage-helper explanations in one guide.
findings.resolution: Retain each complete explanation once, replace later copies with concise same-page links, and place the missing-npm condition before the worker image commands.

findings.finding: Some retained prose still referred to separate compatibility, network, cold-backup, desktop, device or database-import articles.
findings.resolution: Replace those references with explicit links to current guide sections, including same-page links when the material is now on the current guide.

findings.finding: Several French headings and expressions were awkward or ambiguous, including recovering a failure, a possessed project, a bimensual cycle and an empty present day.
findings.resolution: Use natural failure/conflict wording, name project ownership, express one- or two-week cycles directly, and clarify the current-streak and checkbox actions without changing behavior.
